sourceOfTruthNotes: The workspace is the canonical blocked review candidate. It contains eight lessons and 32 stable targets. Deterministic question families provide at least 50 distinct lesson-practice instances per lesson, two balanced review partitions cover all targets, and optional textbook work remains outside mastery. Practice credit is separate from target stages 0/25/50/75/100. Policy c4-mastery-policy-3 requires fresh unaided verification, consistency across two explicit variation categories, paired transfer and reasoning, and a distinct later-session retention task after at least 48 hours in another browser session. State version 4 preserves drafts, first submissions, final corrections, support provenance and earlier unverifiable scores as labelled historical results. The reusable generation contract is versioned under scripts/lib/math-course-generation and this chapter declares its invocation in meta/math-generation.json. Local engineering validation passed; authoring and production release remain blocked until teacher and learner acceptance, real-device accessibility, actual retention and live Brightspace checks pass.
